points.quote: **`base`** holds general utilities and UI building blocks: collections, events, lifecycle and disposables, strings, paths, async helpers, and DOM widgets.
**`platform`** provides services and their dependency-injection infrastructure: files, configuration, storage, instantiation, log, telemetry, and theme.
**`editor`** is the Monaco text editor: model, view, language features, and standalone editor APIs.
**`workbench`** is the full application UI: parts such as the sidebar, panel, and status bar, plus the contributions, services, and features built on them.
**`code`** is the Electron desktop entry point (main process, shared process, and so on).
**`server`** is the remote and web server entry point.
Extensions live outside `src/vs` and talk to the workbench only through the `vscode` API (`workbench/api`).
